belief.answer: Let \(s=\max\{j\in\{0,\ldots,r-1\}:b_j\ne0\}\). Then \(\boxed{\Delta_b=-s}\). Thus the possible values are \(0,-1,\ldots,-(r-1)\), and \(\Delta_b=-s\) if and only if \(b_s\ne0\) and \(b_{s+1}=\cdots=b_{r-1}=0\), with no restrictions on \(b_0,\ldots,b_{s-1}\).
